summary: Three climbers (two males, one female) stuck on the first pitch of Fandango (5.5) on the First Flatiron after starting late into a thunderstorm; they sheltered under a flake as lightning struck within about 20 meters; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks, American Medical Response and the Boulder County Sheriff's Office reached them about 11 p.m. and evacuated all three off the rock by 1:15 a.m., uninjured.
notes: AAC Accidents in North American Climbing, climb year 2013; call about 9:45 p.m. June 28. Inserted run 1015 (Boulder Weekly chunk).
